purpose: Extend California and Texas US state overlays into geometry, coordinates and data/statistics using official state standards.

placement.summary: Define the coordinate plane using perpendicular axes, interpret ordered-pair order and graph/interpret points in the first quadrant.
Extend coordinate work to negative rational coordinates and all four quadrants; use signs, reflections and coordinate distances in problems.
Describe coordinate-plane attributes and ordered-pair order, then graph first-quadrant points from mathematical and real-world problems.
Graph ordered pairs of rational numbers in all four quadrants.

concepts.comparison_note: Both states establish first-quadrant coordinate work in Grade 5 and extend to all four quadrants in Grade 6. California Grade 6 explicitly connects sign changes to reflections across axes; Texas states the four-quadrant rational-point expectation directly.

placement.summary: Draw and identify perpendicular and parallel lines and classify two-dimensional figures using the presence or absence of these line relationships and specified angle sizes.
Identify points, lines, segments, rays, angles, perpendicular and parallel lines, and classify two-dimensional figures by these properties and angle size.

concepts.comparison_note: The Grade 4 expectations are closely aligned in content. MathBridge should show this as an alignment rather than manufacture a difference.

placement.summary: Draw picture graphs and single-unit-scale bar graphs for up to four categories and solve comparison/part-whole problems from the data.
Extend to scaled picture graphs and scaled bar graphs and solve one- and two-step comparison problems.
Explain bar length/picture count, organise up to four categories in pictographs and bar graphs with intervals of one or more, solve problems and draw conclusions/predictions.
Use frequency tables, dot plots, pictographs and bar graphs with scaled intervals and solve one- and two-step categorical-data problems.

concepts.comparison_note: Both states use bar graphs from Grade 2 and scaled displays in Grade 3. Texas Grade 2 explicitly permits bar-graph intervals greater than one and includes conclusions/predictions from graphs.

placement.summary: Understand measures of centre as summaries and use median and/or mean together with measures of variability to describe numerical data in context.
Describe centre, spread and shape and summarise data with mean and median, together with range and interquartile range.

concepts.comparison_note: Both place formal mean/median distribution summaries in Grade 6. Neither should be reduced to 'calculate the average' without the context of distribution and spread.

placement.summary: Interpret scaled categorical graphs and measurement line plots.
Develop statistical-question and variability concepts; describe distributions by centre, spread and shape; display data with dot plots, histograms and box plots and summarise data in context.
Interpret categorical data using frequency tables, dot plots, pictographs and scaled bar graphs.
Represent and solve problems from frequency tables, dot plots and stem-and-leaf plots with whole-number/fraction data.
Use bar graphs/frequency tables for categorical data and dot plots/stem-and-leaf plots for numerical data; add discrete paired data on scatterplots.
Use dot plots, stem-and-leaf plots, histograms and box plots; analyse centre, spread and shape; use mean/median/range/IQR and relative-frequency summaries; interpret numeric displays and variability.

concepts.comparison_note: By Grade 6 both states require distribution-level interpretation, but Texas retains stem-and-leaf plots as an explicit display type while California names dot plots, histograms and box plots.

rendering_rules: If the two states align, say so directly rather than forcing contrast.
Do not relabel a Texas stem-and-leaf plot as a California requirement.
Keep first-quadrant Grade 5 coordinate work separate from all-four-quadrant Grade 6 work.
Use state standards for required content; implementation guidance remains a separate evidence layer.
next_work: Register this extension in the intelligence manifest.
Then shift from curriculum breadth to strengthening misconception/research evidence where current records are curriculum-inferred.
